turns.question: How many customers placed more than three orders between 17 August and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric that counts customers by how many orders they placed in a period, so I can't give that figure. The closest metrics are Active customers (distinct customers with at least one non-cancelled order in the period) and Repeat customers (customers with two or more orders in all, not limited to the period).
